title:
\textbf{The Cycle Class Map, the Reverse Arrow,\\[0.25em]
and a Classical Constructor on Three Fourfolds

claims.statement: The same procedure works for every \(\gamma\in\mathrm{Hdg}^2(Q)\).

Let \(Q\subset\Pspace^5\) be the Klein quadric \eqref{eq:plucker}. The assignment \[ \gamma\;\longmapsto\;\bigl(\Pi,\,\Pi',\,\gamma\cdot[\Pi],\,\gamma\cdot[\Pi']\bigr) \] is a section of \(\mathrm{cl}:Z^2(Q)_{\Q}\to\mathrm{Hdg}^2(Q)\).
